name: MonarchPhoneInput
title: PhoneInput
wrapsNative: MonarchPhoneCountrySelect (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet) above MonarchTextField (androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField) with KeyboardType.Phone and androidx.compose.ui.autofill.ContentType.PhoneNumberNational
summary: A phone number entered as a country calling code and the national number, with one E.164 value out, such as "+442079460958".
whenToUse: Contact, profile, booking and application forms that store a callable number from any country in one format.
whenNotToUse: For codes sent by SMS use MonarchOtpPinInput; for picking only a calling code use MonarchPhoneCountrySelect; for carrier validation or formatting by country use a phone library on the server.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchPhoneInput(value: String?, onValueChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, defaultCountry: String = "US", onCountryChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, countries: List<String>? = null, preferred: List<String> = emptyList(), locale: Locale? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, labels: MonarchPhoneInputLabels = MonarchPhoneInputLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
public class MonarchPhoneInputLabels(invalid: String? = null, country: MonarchPhoneCountrySelectLabels = MonarchPhoneCountrySelectLabels())

public object MonarchPhoneInputDefaults { fun toE164(dialCode: String, national: String, country: String? = null): String?; fun isValidE164(value: String): Boolean; fun parse(phone: String, preferred: String? = null): MonarchPhoneInputParts? }
public data class MonarchPhoneInputParts(country: String, dialCode: String, national: String)

options.name: value
options.description: The number in E.164 ("+442079460958"), or null while there is none. Other international forms ("+44 20 7946 0958", "0044…") are read too.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new E.164 number when the field loses focus, on Done or when the country changes; null when the number is cleared. Never called with an incomplete number.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the whole input.

options.name: defaultCountry
options.description: The ISO code of the country shown while value does not say. Set it from the person's profile or locale.

options.name: onCountryChange
options.description: Called with the ISO code when the country changes, by the picker, a pasted number, a shared calling code or a new value.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label of the number field.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: An example shown while the number is empty and focused.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error from the app. It replaces the input's own "Enter a complete phone number." while present.

options.name: countries
options.description: Limits the picker to these ISO codes; null lists every country with a calling code.

options.name: preferred
options.description: ISO codes listed first in the picker under "Suggested".

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of the country names. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the country and the number can be changed.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Whether the number can be selected and copied but not changed. The picker has no read-only state, so it is disabled.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the message "Enter a complete phone number." and the picker's strings, including its label "Country code".

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus interactions of the number field.

states.name: empty
states.description: The picker shows the default country, the number field its label (and the placeholder when focused); the calling code is shown at the start of the number.

states.name: typing
states.description: The text is kept as typed and nothing is sent; a typed or pasted full international number switches the country at once and keeps the national digits.

states.name: saved
states.description: On focus loss, Done or a country change, the number is joined with the calling code (one leading 0 dropped, except Italy, San Marino and Vatican City) and sent; the field then shows the national digits of the saved value.

states.name: incomplete
states.description: A number of fewer than 8 or more than 15 digits is kept, the field takes the error state with "Enter a complete phone number." and nothing is sent; the next edit clears the message.

states.name: error
states.description: errorText from the app replaces the input's own message and puts the number field in the error state.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Both the picker and the number take the disabled colors and cannot be used.

states.name: read only
states.description: The number can be selected and copied but not changed; the picker is disabled.

appearance: Both parts are Monarch fields: a surface fill with the input border, the focus ring color when focused, muted labels and the calling code in the muted icon color, and the danger strong color for the error outline and message. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web places the picker and the number side by side and wraps them below about 22rem; on a phone the picker is a full-width field above the number, so neither is cut at 320dp or at the largest font size, and the calling code is repeated at the start of the number. The web's controlled country prop is replaced by defaultCountry plus onCountryChange, and its onValueChange details are available from MonarchPhoneInputDefaults.parse; the web's toE164, isValidE164 and parsePhoneNumber are MonarchPhoneInputDefaults.toE164, isValidE164 and parse. The web's sm, md and lg sizes are not offered: Material text fields have one height. Escape to restore the saved number and the hidden form input have no meaning on Android. The calling-code table is MonarchPhoneCountrySelect's, so both stay in step. iOS has no PhoneInput entry yet; the names follow the web and MonarchCurrencyInput.
accessibility: The picker is MonarchPhoneCountrySelect's exposed dropdown, named "Country code"; the number is a Material 3 text field named by its label, so TalkBack reads them as two elements.
The number field asks for the phone keyboard and is marked as a national phone number for autofill.
An incomplete number sets the field's error semantics to "Enter a complete phone number." and shows it as text, so it is not shown by color alone.
The number is shown left to right on a right-to-left screen, with a left-to-right mark that is not part of the value.
Both parts are at least 48dp high, also at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Several countries share a calling code (+1, +7, +44): a number is moved to the country of its leading digits (+1 242 is the Bahamas), otherwise it stays with the chosen country, otherwise the code's main country.
Arabic-Indic, Persian and full-width digits are read as 0 to 9; spaces, brackets, dots and hyphens are ignored.
A pasted number that starts with + or 00 but matches no calling code is flagged as incomplete on Done.
Only the length is checked (8 to 15 digits after the plus), so a number of the right length that is not in service is accepted.
Clearing the number sends null; changing the country while the number is empty sends nothing.

examples.title: In a Field with suggested countries
examples.webExample: In a Field with suggested countries
examples.template:
MonarchPhoneInput(
    value = phone,
    onValueChange = { phone = it },
    label = {{label}},
    helperText = {{storedAs}} + " " + (phone ?: {{nothingYet}}) + ".",
    preferred = listOf({{preferred.0}}, {{preferred.1}}, {{preferred.2}}),
)
examples.code:
MonarchPhoneInput(
    value = phone,
    onValueChange = { phone = it },
    label = "Phone",
    helperText = "Stored as" + " " + (phone ?: "nothing yet") + ".",
    preferred = listOf("GB", "US", "IN"),
)

examples.title: Limited countries with the country kept by the app
examples.setup:
var mobile by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
var country by remember { mutableStateOf("IN") }
examples.code:
MonarchPhoneInput(
    value = mobile,
    onValueChange = { mobile = it },
    defaultCountry = country,
    onCountryChange = { country = it },
    label = "Mobile",
    countries = listOf("IN", "AE", "SG"),
)
